name: – David McAllister – After § 41 – Am 48
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: 41b. Condemns the repression and criminalisation of solidarity with the Palestinian people across Europe and recalls that all persons in Europe have the right to engage in free assembly and peaceful protest under Articles 10 and 11 of the European Convention on Human Rights;
